produced_by.note: No INV record exists in this repository yet. The evidence behind every VERIFIED value below is the captured output in docs/tools.md, produced by scripts/check_tools.sh.

url.note: Served by the NIST Biometric Open Source Server over HTTPS with no registration, and listed on the NIGOS products page. The build fetches this URL directly.

archive_sha256.note: Checked before the archive is unpacked; sha256sum -c exits non-zero on a mismatch, which fails the build.

release.note: The NIGOS page lists it as the stable version.

release_date.note: The NIGOS page gives (03/04/2015). The server's Last-Modified header for the archive reads Tue, 03 Mar 2015 20:57:05 GMT, one day earlier; both were read directly and the page's date is taken as the release date.

upstream.note: The source is obtained from the publisher rather than corroborated through a third party: it is downloaded from nist.gov over HTTPS and its checksum is verified before use. This status rests on provenance of the download, not on any comparison against another copy.

mirror_previously_used.note: The recipe in build below was worked out against this mirror, which is why it is recorded rather than deleted. Compared against this archive: 3879 paths on both sides, none missing from either, 593 byte-identical, 3286 differing only in line endings (the mirror carries CRLF, the archive LF), and none differing in content. Built in the same directory, the mirror produces the byte-identical binary recorded below.

base_image.note: Builder and runtime share this base, so the binary cannot need a newer glibc than the runtime provides.

patch.note: rules.mak is generated by setup.sh. Without -fcommon the build fails in an2k/histogen with a multiple definition of histo_head, because GCC 10 made -fno-common the default. The Dockerfile asserts that line 142 carries the flag after patching.

make.note: The whole tree is built; the packages share libraries and pruning the build introduces failures of its own.

extra_build_packages.note: cmake is required by the openjp2 package, which make config builds before anything else.

artifact_copied.note: One file crosses the stage boundary. No compiler, no source tree and no other NBIS tool reaches the runtime image.

sha256.note: Of the binary as it sits in the runtime image built from this Dockerfile. mindtct reports no version of its own, so this digest is its identity.

shared_libraries.note: libpng and zlib are linked statically by the NBIS build, so the runtime image needs no additional packages for this tool.

flags.note: Called with no flags. -m1 is deliberately not passed.

input_format.note: This build defines __NBIS_PNG__. TIFF and PGM are both refused with 'image type UNKNOWN : not supported', so a TIFF dataset is converted with Pillow .convert("L") before it reaches the tool.

outputs.note: Eight files per input, all byte-identical across repeated runs on the same PNG.

dataset.note: No dataset manifest exists yet, so the images are identified by the name of the directory they were read from and not by a checksummed set. When a dataset manifest is issued this field is replaced by its id.

conversion.value: Pillow .convert("L"), decoded pixels identical to the TIFF
conversion.note: The PNG file itself is not checksummed: PNG encoding varies with the zlib and Pillow version while the decoded pixels do not.
